messages.subject: chunk_alloc & thread_safe
parts:
I'm enhancing reverse mode for the ODE solver, and ran across
two classes I don't think we need and which have no tests
associated with them:

1. src/stan/memory/chunk_alloc.hpp

This isn't used anywhere in Stan C++ or in CmdStan. Can I just
remove it?

2. src/stan/agrad/agrad_thread_safe.hpp

This one hasn't been kept up to date and it's just a bad cut-and-paste
job, so I removed it. If we need the functionality, the right thing to do
is just prefix the global declarations for autodiff with __thread
conditioned on an environment variable being defined.

- Bob
